abstract: Production skill for Synthetic's zero-data-retention web search API. Turns natural-language requests into focused queries with compact, cited results, and documents live-measured limits from 2026-10-18: five results per search, a 4,096-character effective query, a 100,000-character hard cap, working site: operators, silently ignored body parameters, the undocumented highlights field, and hourly search quota accounting.
